gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i2: Tests for {@link BritishCutoverChronology}, the British Julian-Gregorian cutover calendar system.

Each test exercises a single public method of the chronolog
ADDED i3: --------------------------------------------------------------------------- range(ChronoField) - returns a non-null ValueRange for every supported field -------
ADDED i5: For the BC era, the proleptic year is 1 - yearOfEra, so 538 BC -> -537.
ADDED i6: For the AD era, the proleptic year equals the year-of-era.
ADDED i7: dateYearDay delegates to prolepticYear, which requires a JulianEra.
ADDED i9: date(Era, ...) delegates to prolepticYear, which requires a JulianEra.
ADDED i16: The Julian-based calendar has exactly two eras: BC and AD.
